# Sticker fixtures for WCA slice Moves, each applied once to a solved cube in the home frame
# (WHITE on U, GREEN on F, RED on R). Hand-derived, not generated by the code under test.
#
# Format: <token> <54 letters>, letters W Y G B R O. Faces in URFDLB order, 9 letters each,
# row-major per the Kociemba net, as the Learner sees the cube after the Move:
#
#              U0 U1 U2                 U: B edge on top
#              U3 U4 U5                 D: F edge on top
#              U6 U7 U8                 R, F, L, B: U edge on top
#   L0 L1 L2   F0 F1 F2   R0 R1 R2   B0 B1 B2
#   L3 L4 L5   F3 F4 F5   R3 R4 R5   B3 B4 B5
#   L6 L7 L8   F6 F7 F8   R6 R7 R8   B6 B7 B8
#              D0 D1 D2
#              D3 D4 D5
#              D6 D7 D8
#
# Spaces inside the 54 letters are not allowed; faces below are   U        R        F        D        L        B
